setting: A hackathon team of three in the last hours before submission, talking around a table in the venue at about 5:40 AM on Sunday.
facts: Submission deadline is 9:00 AM Sunday, submitted through the Devpost form.
The demo video can be at most 3 minutes long and must be submitted as a YouTube or Vimeo link.
Judging rubric weights: technical complexity 30%, impact 30%, design 20%, presentation 20%.
The team's project is ShelfLife, an app that tracks pantry expiry dates from photos of grocery receipts.
The OCR API free tier allows 1,000 requests per month; the team has used 812 so far this month.
Earlier the team decided Jun records the demo voiceover and Marcus edits the video.
The GitHub repo must be public at submission time; it is currently private.
Live judging demo slots start at 10:30 AM in Room 204.
